column1: # The focus key picture and text of the focus page, per remote, and the remote each model ships with.
# Stock: newsettings RemoteFocusCell.refreshRemoteControlView (release_838 of G0111 and G0155, same code, also on HB release_838)
# picks the picture and the text by persist.xgimi.rc.version, the remote's own firmware string that the stock Bluetooth
# service reads over GATT (XgimiRcInfo 0x2A26 / 0x2A28) and saves. Lumen never reads that string, so the model's own
# remote below decides (data, read by apps/core/lumen-menu/test/FocusGuideTest.java against every devices/*/menu.json
#  rule  match (substrings of the version, '|' = any, checked top down as stock, '*' = anything left)  token
#        (menu.json hints focus.guide, '-' = Lumen has no picture for it)  stock picture  stock text  key
#  model  model code  remote version  evidence
